cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(vins_sensors CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 11)
find_package(catkin REQUIRED COMPONENTS roscpp sensor_msgs std_msgs)
find_package(OpenCV 4.2 REQUIRED COMPONENTS core imgproc)
include_directories(${catkin_INCLUDE_DIRS} ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS} "${SPINNAKER_ROOT}/include")
add_executable(vins_imu gnw.cpp)
target_link_libraries(vins_imu ${catkin_LIBRARIES})
add_executable(vins_camera camera.cpp)
target_link_libraries(vins_camera ${catkin_LIBRARIES} ${OpenCV_LIBRARIES} "${SPINNAKER_ROOT}/lib/libSpinnaker.so")
target_link_options(vins_camera PRIVATE "-Wl,-rpath-link,${SPINNAKER_ROOT}/lib")
